title: WPMS/18/2014 of Nupur Singh @ Nupur Chauhan Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition (M/S) No.18 of 2014
Nupur Singh @ Nupur Chauhan ÖÖ Petitioner
Versus
State of Uttarakhand & others Ö.Ö Respondents
Present: Mr. Rakesh Thapliyal, Advocate, present for the petitioner.
Mr. N.P. Shah, Standing counsel, present for the State of
Uttarkahand/respondent nos. 1 & 2.
Mr. Manish Arora, Advocate, present for the respondent nos. 3
to 5.

Honíble Sudhanshu Dhulia, J. (Oral)
1. The petitioner is the wife of one Shri Dhruv
Singh, who passed away on 18.08.2012. There is a property
situated at 48, Civil Lines, Roorkee, District Haridwar i.e.
ìMotel Polarisî which is in the name of petitionerís husband
Late Shri Dhruv Singh in the municipal records. The
records have to be changed in accordance with Section 213
of the U.P. Municipal Corporation Act, 1959. The difficulty,
however, with the Municipal Corporation is that there are
more than one claimants who want their names to be
substituted such as (a) Mrs. Nupur Singh @ Nupur
Chauhan (present petitioner) being the widow of late Shri
Dhruv Singh, and (b) the private respondent nos. 6, 7 and
8 who are the sisters of late Shri Dhruv Singh. This Court
is not giving any opinion as to whose name should come in
Municipal Corporation records. It is for the municipal
authorities to see, who shall hear the present petitioner as
well as private respondent nos. 6, 7 and 8 by giving them
due opportunity of hearing and appreciating their
documents and claim and thereafter pass an appropriate
order.

2
2. Let the needful be done as expeditiously as
possible.
3. Since reappraisal in the matter has to be done by
the concerned authority, the order dated 26.07.2013,
passed by the Mukhya Nagar Adhikari, Nagar Nigam,
Roorkee, District Haridwar by which instructions have been
issued to correct the name in the municipal record on the
basis of applications moved by the private respondent nos.
6, 7 and 8 is hereby quashed. Let the needful be done in
accordance with law.
4. Writ petition disposed. No order as to costs.
 (Sudhanshu Dhulia, J.)
 14.08.2014
ML
